name: io.github.iowarp/parquet-mcp
title: CLIO Parquet
description: MCP server for Apache Parquet files

tools.name: summarize_tool
tools.description: Return Parquet schema, row count, and file size.

tools.name: read_slice_tool
tools.description: Read a row slice from a Parquet file with optional column projection and filtering.

tools.name: get_column_preview_tool
tools.description: Preview values from a specific column with pagination.

tools.name: aggregate_column_tool
tools.description: Compute aggregate statistics (min, max, mean, etc.) on a Parquet column.

prompts.name: analyze_parquet
prompts.description: Guided workflow for analyzing a Parquet file.
